images.title: LRO, LCROSS Liftoff on Lunar Journey
images.description: The Lunar Reconnaissance Orbiter and Lunar Crater Observation and Sensing Satellite are bound for the moon after a flawless liftoff Thursday, June 18, 2009, from Cape Canaveral Air Force Station in Florida aboard an Atlas V rocket. Photo Credit: (NASA/Bill Ingalls)

images.title: Diviner Following Integration to the Lunar Reconnaissance Orbiter LRO
images.description: The Diviner instrument following integration to NASA Lunar Reconnaissance Orbiter. Diviner is one of seven instruments aboard the Lunar Reconnaissance Orbiter.

images.title: Loading Lunar Reconnaissance Orbiter LRO in the Thermal Vacuum Chamber
images.description: Loading the Lunar Reconnaissance Orbiter into the thermal vacuum chamber at Goddard Space Flight Center. Diviner is one of seven instruments aboard NASA LRO Mission.

videos.title: Return with LRO
videos.credit: Rich Melnick, Chris Meaney, Cathy Peddie
videos.description: The Deputy Project Manager for the Lunar Reconnaissance Orbiter (LRO) program, Cathy Peddie, expresses her personal and professional thoughts on the upcoming LRO mission.
